newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan private machinery orders on rising trend - EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan private machinery orders on rising trend - EPA.

text.p: Japan's private machinery orders continue to be on a rising trend, the Economic Planning Agency said on Tuesday.
Earlier, EPA data showed that core private machinery orders in March fell a seasonally adjusted 12.7 percent from the previous month.
Orders in the same category for the January to March period fell 7.0 percent from the previous quarter but those for the April-June period were seen rising 4.5 percent.
